title: 2022 Score - #162 Brandon Aiyuk San Francisco 49ers
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2022 Score sports trading card features Brandon Aiyuk from the San Francisco 49ers. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 162. It is perfect for collectors who are fans of the National Football League (NFL) and enjoy collecting football trading cards. The card is manufactured by Panini and is not autographed. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and is from the 2022 season.
